newEvidence.summary: With StableStakerV2 live (ECON-001), each USDe autoAnnihilate MINTS phUSD for (target - delivered); story-028 NatSpec names the strategy's slippageToleranceBps as the bound. At bps B, up to ~B x netWanted unbacked phUSD per exit; self-sandwich captures the part above the natural NAV-to-pool gap (~6.3 bps live). At B = MAX_BPS the bound vanishes. Footgun chain: when the sUSDe discount widens past B every exit reverts (L-01 persistent variant), and the documented remedy (also DEDUP-18-04's) is to raise B -- a vault-parameter edit that silently raises a phUSD-supply cap. Reward-bounded per call (netWanted = min(owed reward, principal)). At B=30 self-sandwich is unprofitable at live scale.
newEvidence.severityTrigger: Rises toward Medium if B is raised well above the natural gap while large reward balances are outstanding.
newEvidence.recommendation: Document in setSlippageTolerance NatSpec and vault CLAUDE.md that B bounds downstream minted phUSD per exit; cap B well below MAX_BPS (also closes L-01); runbook: prefer pausing autoAnnihilate over a standing high B.
